role_families.family: Business and data analysis / data quality

source_requirements_paraphrased: The advert asks for matric and an Informatics or other relevant degree.
It describes requirements elicitation, business process modelling, solution design, testing/UAT, stakeholder work, documentation and incident analysis.
It lists 2-3 years of business analysis experience and 1 year of user interface analyst experience; business experience/product knowledge is an advantage.
Advanced UML, BPMN and project-management training are listed under certifications.
employer_examples.candidate_eligibility: The advert does not state nationality, age, or a specific BCom Informatics equivalence rule. Assess degree relevance and experience against the employer; no personal eligibility conclusion is made.

source_requirements_paraphrased: The role concerns NLP/LLM data science, prototyping, evaluation, literature review, delivery and communication to technical and business audiences.
The advert names SQL/database work, Python, problem definition and clear communication; Git, R, NLP, TensorFlow/PyTorch, LLMs and Spark/Dask are advantageous.
It asks for an Honours or Master's degree in named or similar quantitative fields; a PhD is advantageous, and other qualifications may be considered with relevant experience.
The advert says candidates at all experience levels will be considered.
employer_examples.candidate_eligibility: No nationality or age condition is stated. A BCom Informatics degree is not explicitly named; the advert's 'similar quantitative field' and experience wording should not be treated as an automatic equivalence.

proposed_portfolio_project.name: KAIRO Opportunity Evidence Board
proposed_portfolio_project.description: A local, manually curated demo that turns a small synthetic role dataset into traceable requirements, data-quality checks and a decision dashboard. Keep real employer postings as cited human-reviewed source records; use synthetic values for the working dataset.
measurable_working_tasks: Write a one-page problem statement, 6 user stories and 10 acceptance criteria for a role-evidence workflow.
Model one current-to-future workflow and document 8 field definitions with source lineage and allowed unknown states.
Create 20 synthetic role records and 8 repeatable data-quality rules; seed at least 6 known defects and show each detected defect with a test record.
Use SQL to produce 5 decision queries and a dashboard with counts by role family, status evidence and missing requirement fields.
Publish a short findings memo that states which conclusions are supported, unknown or out of scope.
proposed_portfolio_project.success_measure_note: These numbers are proposed portfolio acceptance criteria, not employer thresholds or evidence of completed work.

source_requirements_paraphrased: The 2026 FNB Engineering & Technology graduate advert describes permanent full-time work on end-to-end technology solutions across design, development, testing, implementation and systems management.

It asks for strong academic results and an academic transcript, final-year study in relevant university programmes particularly technology or engineering, and strong coding aptitude with analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills.
The programme description includes monthly training and an action-learning project.
employer_examples.candidate_eligibility: The advert names technology or engineering fields but does not explicitly list BCom Informatics. It does not provide a citizenship or age requirement in the retrieved text. The posting closed 2026-08-31, before the checked date.

proposed_portfolio_project.name: Offline Source-to-Lesson Service
proposed_portfolio_project.description: A small local prototype that imports synthetic learning notes, produces a traceable lesson outline, and handles missing or unsupported content safely without a network connection.
measurable_working_tasks: Define a versioned request/response schema and document 6 error cases.
Implement a deterministic local flow for 5 synthetic source files and preserve source references for every generated lesson section.
Add at least 12 automated cases covering valid input, malformed data, unsupported claims, restart and offline behavior.
Record cold-start time and memory use over 10 local runs, publishing the measurement method and raw results.
proposed_portfolio_project.success_measure_note: These counts and measurements are proposed portfolio acceptance criteria, not FNB requirements or completed results. Keep any AI-generated output visibly marked as unverified until reviewed.

role_families.family: Digital customer support and service operations

source_requirements_paraphrased: The role supports members, advisors, healthcare professionals and employers with digital products and technical issues.
Duties include troubleshooting across digital platforms, explaining tools, helping users manage and secure accounts, and logging/tracking/resolving incidents.
The listed skills are communication, empathy, problem-solving, technical skills, resilience and time management.
The advert asks for matric and at least one year of call-centre/customer-service experience.
employer_examples.candidate_eligibility: No nationality, age or post-matric qualification rule is stated. The one-year experience condition is explicit; a portfolio project does not replace it.

proposed_portfolio_project.name: KAIRO Digital Support Case Simulator
proposed_portfolio_project.description: A private local practice simulator using synthetic account, document-upload and audio-playback support cases, with an incident log, safe troubleshooting checklist and escalation notes.
measurable_working_tasks: Create 12 synthetic cases across 3 issue types and define the expected safe resolution or escalation for each.
Write a support playbook with identity/privacy checks, 5 diagnostic questions per issue type and a clear escalation boundary.
Run all 12 cases against the playbook and record first-step accuracy, correct escalation and time per case; show the raw synthetic scenario results.
Build a local dashboard for case category, outcome, unresolved reason and median simulated handling time.
proposed_portfolio_project.success_measure_note: The case count and metrics are proposed portfolio acceptance criteria using synthetic scenarios; they do not establish real customer-service performance or satisfy the advert's experience condition.

experience_providers.evidence_summary: mLab describes coding training and work experience, with a portfolio of Android, iOS and web solutions and additional cloud, Scrum and emerging-technology exposure. It says final-year WIL students are encouraged and names BCom Informatics (Information Systems) among example related qualifications.
listed_criteria_paraphrased: The page describes a 6-12 month programme.

It lists South African citizenship, unemployed youth/graduate age 18-35, proximity to a CodeTribe Academy facility, no criminal record, and at least 12 months of IT qualification/NQF level 5 with programming background among ideal candidate criteria.
Final-year students doing WIL are also encouraged to apply.

experience_providers.cost: unknown; not stated on source page
experience_providers.fit_note: Potentially relevant to software and applied business-informatics portfolios; these are provider criteria, not employer requirements or a promise of placement.

experience_providers.type: national technology and vocational skills competition
experience_providers.evidence_summary: The official government announcement says the 2027 national competition application window is 2026-09-01 through 2027-04-30. WorldSkills South Africa's official skills listing includes IT Software Solutions for Business. The application page lists study/apprenticeship-related eligibility routes.
listed_criteria_paraphrased: Applicants must be studying a qualification related to the skill at a listed institution, in a related apprenticeship/learnership, or have an accredited qualification in the skill, as summarized in the dated government announcement.
The provider application page asks for institution province and institution/provider name.
experience_providers.current_status_on_checked_date: official government announcement says applications opened 2026-09-01 and close 2027-04-30; confirm the desired skill's current terms on the application page
experience_providers.cost: unknown; not stated on reviewed official pages
experience_providers.conflict_note: The application form contains an age note referring to 2028 for three skills. That note is inconsistent in cycle labeling with the separate 2027 competition dates, so age-specific eligibility is unresolved here.

conflicts_and_unknowns: The FNB Workday page did not yield readable text through direct opening; the official indexed job text supplied the requisition and 2026-08-31 closing date. The page was marked expired because that stated deadline has passed.

Discovery's Junior Data Scientist, Business Analyst and Digital Support pages were visible with Apply actions on 2026-10-22, but no closing date or explicit open/closed status was shown. Their application status is therefore unknown.
No source in this pack establishes that a particular BCom Informatics student meets the Discovery data-science degree wording or the FNB technology programme's relevant-programme wording.
mLab intake dates and participant fees were not shown on the reviewed page.

WorldSkills South Africa's application page contains a 2028 age note while the separate official 2027 competition announcement gives the current round dates. Verify skill-specific age rules with the provider before relying on them.
Employer requisition numbers were displayed only for the FNB advert (R46838); the reviewed Discovery pages did not display a requisition number in extracted content.
Portfolio tasks and numeric acceptance measures in this pack are suggestions for future work. They are not employer requirements, and no performance or completion result is claimed.
